title: 21 in. Super Recycler Personal Pace SmartStow 190cc Briggs&amp;Stratton Electric Start Self Propelled Walk Behind Lawn Mower
description:
Easy Street. This is only the beginning, once the engine’s revving, and handy options like electric start, deliver. Leveraging time-tested Toro engineering, the Super Recycler delivers the perfect cut every time, while nourishing your lawn to provide a rich, green cut that landscape pros relish. Fertilize your lawn while you mow…
Simply push the button and you’re ready to mow with electric start.
Superior clean cut performance with dual blade accelerator and wedges.
Supercharge your cut with Vortex Technology allowing greater under-deck airflow; delivering a lush green lawn.
Save up to 70% more room* with SmartStow vertical storage.
Long lasting durability with commercial-grade cast-aluminum deck.
Mow at your own pace with Personal Pace Auto-Drive self-propel that adjusts to your walking speed.
Glide over holes and bumps with FLEX Handle Suspension. No more achy hands and stiff muscles!
Lightweight and maneuverable with rear traction high wheels
